about: Page checks for the reviewed camera uplinks: each provider's public viewing page was requested once (same-origin fetch from the provider's own site, or opened in a browser tab for other origins; tools/verify_uplinks.js). A check says the page answered as a working page on the provider's host on that date. It says nothing about whether the camera stream itself was live, and no stream, player or image was requested.
